mechanism_narrative: A sustained low federal funds rate environment consistently reduces discount rates applied to equity cash flows, generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days without requiring specific threshold conditions.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are negative in >60% of periods when FEDFUNDS < 3.5% and mean return is not significantly positive (t-test p>0.05).

mechanism_narrative: When year-over-year CPI inflation exceeds 4.0%, the Federal Reserve initiates monetary tightening that increases equity discount rates, producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in >60% of periods when CPIAUCSL YoY > 4.0% and mean return is not significantly negative (t-test p>0.05).

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in housing starts (HOUST) and retail sales (RSAFS) signal broad consumer demand contraction, triggering negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days through reduced corporate revenue expectations.
candidate_trigger: HOUST and RSAFS both decline >0.5% from prior month
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in >60% of periods when HOUST and RSAFS both decline >0.5% and mean return is not significantly negative (t-test p>0.05).

mechanism_narrative: In high-unemployment regimes (UNRATE > 5.0%), the Federal Reserve maintains accommodative monetary policy that supports equity valuations, generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in >60% of periods when UNRATE > 5.0% and mean return is not significantly positive (t-test p>0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained expansion in industrial production (INDPRO) indicates robust manufacturing activity that correlates with strong corporate earnings growth, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days without threshold conditions.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in >60% of periods when INDPRO is rising and mean return is not significantly positive (t-test p>0.05).

mechanism_narrative: When housing starts fall below 2000.0 thousand units, it signals housing market contraction that reduces consumer spending and leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in >60% of periods when HOUST < 2000.0 and mean return is not significantly negative (t-test p>0.05).

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous federal funds rate increases (FEDFUNDS) and high inflation (CPIAUCSL > 4.0%) signal aggressive monetary tightening that compresses equity valuations, producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in >60% of periods when FEDFUNDS increases >0.25% and CPIAUCSL > 4.0% and mean return is not significantly negative (t-test p>0.05).

mechanism_narrative: In slow-growth regimes (GDPC1 annualized growth < 1.5%), reduced corporate profit growth leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days as economic momentum weakens.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in >60% of periods when GDPC1 annualized growth < 1.5% and mean return is not significantly negative (t-test p>0.05).
